newsitem.title: THAILAND: RESEARCH ALERT-Bangkok Bank rated buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Bangkok Bank rated buy.

text.p: Thai Farmers Research Center Co Ltd on Tuesday rated Bangkok Bank Plc a buy on weakness for long term investment.
Thai Farmers said Bangkok Bank has consistently secured its position as Thailand's biggest commercial bank by its asset quality, strong capital base, and above average loan loss reserves.
Bangkok Bank closed Tuesday up four baht at 177.
Thai Farmers said Bangkok Bank's accrued interest earnings rose only 17 percent year-on-year at end-March against almost 23 percent for the Thai banking industry.
It said the bank's non-performing loans stood at five percent of its total lending in 1996 against seven or eight percent for the entire sector.
Bangkok Bank had 22.19 percent and 21.72 percent of the sector's total lending and deposits, respectively, at end-May.
"Retail banking via branches nationwide remains BBL's operation strength that helps the bank to be ahead of competitors," it said.
Thai Farmers said at the end of the first quarter, Bangkok Bank's enjoyed a bigger, more profitable interest margin of 3.59 percent against 3.03 percent for the overall industry.
